name: balance-stack
title: Balance Stack
description: A dark balance card with payment cards stacked along its edge: tap one to pull it forward as the figure counts.

perf.budget: Cards move on short UI-thread springs; the figure re-renders only while it counts. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards take their places and the figure changes without moving or counting.
a11y.screenReader: The header reads as one line ("Savings Vault, €18,904.60, Earning") and each card as a button ("NOVA card ending 6190") with its selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: At least 61 pt of each card stays exposed and tappable.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { BalanceStack } from '@/components/kinetik/balance-stack';

<BalanceStack
  label="Savings Vault"
  status="Earning"
  currency="€"
  accounts={[
    { id: 'travel', balance: 6240.18, digits: '2048', network: 'NOVA' },
    { id: 'daily', balance: 18904.6, digits: '6190', network: 'NOVA' },
  ]}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A home screen or wallet summary for one person with two or three accounts.
- Switching between accounts where the balance is the thing people came to read.

## When not to use

- More than three accounts: only three fit, so use a list.
- When every account must be read at once. Only the front one shows its balance.

## Notes

- Pass `selected` and `onSelect` to control which account is at the front.
- `network` is plain text, so use your own wordmark. Check the rules before showing a real card network's name.
- The card stays dark in the light theme so the coloured cards keep their contrast.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add balance-stack`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
